questions.question: When Philistine archers wounded King Saul in battle, what did he ask his armor-bearer to do?

answers.text: Run him through with a sword
Carry him down off the mountain
Hold off the archers for him

questions.question: When the people of Jabesh-gilead heard what the Philistines did to King Saul, what did their men of valor do?

answers.text: They brought back the bodies of Saul and his sons
They attacked the temple of the Philistine gods
They sent gifts to buy back the bodies

questions.question: What reason does the Bible give for why King Saul died?

answers.text: He was unfaithful to the LORD
He lost his courage in battle
He grew proud of his power
